game_title: Case Choir – Cloud Sea Overlook Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Frost Peaks – Cloud Sea Overlook, an overlook above the clouds: the avalanche scout must handle yetis while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Case Choir: Convert text with upper(), lower(), and title() to match the choir's tune.
theme: Frost Peaks – Cloud Sea Overlook: an overlook above the clouds
core_gameplay_loop: In Cloud Sea Overlook, repeat each round: Convert text with upper(), lower(), and title() to match the choir's tune. Each round, yetis strike the pass gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the choir value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the pass gate from yetis in Cloud Sea Overlook: keep the choir meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 71-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: choir drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 71-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 8 (extended tier): Case Choir
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Case Choir' (Week 8 slot 3), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Cloud Sea Overlook'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how choir changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against yetis in Cloud Sea Overlook.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 71 seconds while choir > 0.
